title: "Germination"
format: html

# Germination experiment for norther dragonhead (*Dracocephalum ruyschiana*) at Horgen, Frogn municipality, Norway.

## Required packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(gt)

```

## Import data

```{r}
df <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("data", "Frøspiring_data.xlsx"))
```

## Create overview table of experiment

```{r}
#Assign plots to a transect
transekt_key <- tibble(
  Plot = 1:10,
  Transekt = c(
    rep("Vestlig", 5),
    rep("Østlig", 5)
  )
)

#Create table that shows experimental setup
# Én kolonne per smårute
forsoksoppsett <- df %>%
  select(Plot, Subplot, Treatment) %>%
  left_join(transekt_key, by = "Plot") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Subplot,
    values_from = Treatment,
    names_prefix = "S",
    names_sort = TRUE
  ) %>%
  arrange(Transekt, Plot) %>%
  relocate(Transekt, Plot)

# Smårutekolonner og norske kolonneoverskrifter
smarutekolonner <- grep("^S[0-9]+$", names(forsoksoppsett), value = TRUE)

smaruteetiketter <- setNames(
  as.list(sub("^S", "", smarutekolonner)),
  smarutekolonner
)

tab_forsoksoppsett <- forsoksoppsett %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Forsøksoppsett for frøspiring hos dragehode",
    subtitle = "Fordeling av behandlinger mellom småruter"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Transekt = "Transekt",
    Plot = "Rute",
    .list = smaruteetiketter
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Smårute",
    columns = all_of(smarutekolonner)
  ) %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#E8EEF4"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = all_of(smarutekolonner),
      rows = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = "C = kontroll (ingen behandling); S = stratifisering."
  ) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "") %>%
  opt_row_striping() %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 14,
    data_row.padding = px(8)
  )

tab_forsoksoppsett

#Save as word file
gt::gtsave(
  data = tab_forsoksoppsett,
  filename = here::here("img", "Forsoksoppsett_dragehode.docx")
)
```
